description: BlueGene RAS node hardware fault escalating to node taken offline

logs.message: RAS: node R00-M0-N04 initialized, health check passed, 16 cores online
RAS: node R00-M0-N04 temperature rising: 78C, threshold 85C — cooling check advised
RAS: node R00-M0-N04 hardware fault detected — ECC memory errors increasing: 47 in last 60s
RAS: node R00-M0-N04 taken offline — fatal hardware fault confirmed, 16 jobs killed and rescheduled
